title: Mugler perfume: Alien, Angel and Les Exceptions compared
body:
Mugler's fragrances fall into a few clear families: Alien, built around jasmine and amber; Angel, sweet and gourmand; the fresh Mugler Colognes; and the Les Exceptions collection. Here is every Mugler perfume we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

Mugler Alien: jasmine and white amber

Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum (from £50.99, 30ml or 90ml, refillable) has just three notes: jasmine sambac, cashmeran wood and white amber. That short list makes it clear and easy to read on the skin: bright jasmine first, then a smooth, slightly powdery wood and a warm amber finish. It is a statement scent for evenings and colder weather.

Alien Goddess Supra Florale Eau de Parfum (from £26.99, 10ml, 60ml or 90ml) keeps the jasmine but makes it more floral: a cactus flower accord, jasmine grandiflorum and everlasting flower absolute. The original Alien Goddess (bergamot and coconut water, jasmine and heliotrope, over Bourbon vanilla and cashmeran) is in our Alien Goddess gift set, currently out of stock.

Alien Man

The Alien Man Eau de Toilette & Body Shampoo Travel Set (£57.99) pairs a refillable 100ml eau de toilette with a 50ml body shampoo. The scent opens with beech wood, dill, anise, lavender, lemon, mint and thyme, moves to leather, osmanthus, pepper and geranium, and dries down to white amber, cashmeran and vanilla: herbal at first, then warm and leathery.

Mugler Angel: sweet and gourmand

Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum (£44.99, 25ml) is the dessert of the family. Cotton candy, coconut, cassis and fruit open it; honey, red berries, plum and flowers fill the heart; and patchouli, chocolate, caramel, vanilla and tonka bean make the base. The contrast between the sugary notes and the earthy patchouli is what gives it its character. A bold pick for winter nights and parties.

  • Angel Elixir Eau de Parfum (from £57.99, 50ml or 100ml, refillable star bottle): pink pepper, then ylang-ylang, orange blossom, jasmine and sandalwood, over Bourbon vanilla and amber. More floral than Angel, with a warm, cosy finish.
  • Angel Nova Eau de Toilette (£50.99, 50ml): lychee and bergamot, rose and magnolia, over akigalawood and amberwood. The lightest and fruitiest of the Angel scents, easy for daytime and spring.

Mugler Les Exceptions

Les Exceptions is Mugler's collection of eau de parfums, both unisex and in 80ml bottles. You will also find them in our niche perfume edit.

  • Les Exceptions Wonder Bouquet (£60.99): shiso, lily of the valley, petitgrain, orange and tangerine, then brioche, jasmine sambac, tuberose, orange blossom and rose, over beeswax, hazelnut, vanilla and cashmeran. A rich floral with a soft, bakery-sweet edge.
  • Les Exceptions Mystic Aromatic (£60.99): thyme, basil, clary sage and fig leaf, then grey amber, over Peru balsam and cedarwood. Green and herbal, with a resinous base.

Mugler Colognes: four 10ml minis

The Mugler Colognes are fresh eau de toilettes in 10ml sprays at £14.99 each, a low-cost way to try something new:

  • Blow It Up: sorbet, vetiver and black currant.
  • Fly Away: grapefruit, a green cannabis accord and vetiver.
  • Heal Your Mind (sold for men): lavender, hazelnut and vanilla.
  • Love You All: blue liquorice, white amber and musk.

Small sizes like these make easy stocking fillers; our mini perfume sets guide has more ideas.

Which Mugler perfume should you choose?

  • You like warm, statement florals: Alien, or Alien Goddess Supra Florale for more flowers.
  • You love sweet, dessert-like scents: Angel, or Angel Elixir for a more floral version.
  • You want something light and fruity: Angel Nova.
  • Buying for him: the Alien Man set.
  • You like something different and unisex: Les Exceptions Wonder Bouquet or Mystic Aromatic.
  • You want to try before you commit: a 10ml Mugler Cologne, or the 10ml Alien Goddess Supra Florale.

Good to know

  • Refillable bottles: Alien, Angel Elixir and the Alien Man eau de toilette come in bottles made to be refilled.
  • Eau de parfum or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • As a gift: see our perfume gift sets guide for more Christmas ideas.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

summary: The Mugler fragrances we stock, side by side: Alien and Alien Goddess, Angel, Angel Elixir and Angel Nova, Alien Man, the Les Exceptions collection and the 10ml colognes.
